missionSettings.description: FAULT LINE 5/5 - BATTLE FOR BRUSSELS. Neither side can win the war in pieces. Every airbase on the map is now in play, and the North's war industry sits beside Brussels Airport, the South's beside Brussels South Charleroi. Income grows with every base you hold. Take every enemy airbase and destroy the enemy factories to end the war. Both sides playable: PvP, or co-op against the AI. Long mission. Requires NOCustomMaps and the Belgica map (Nuclear Option Mod Manager). Fictional scenario: North = Boscali, South = Primeva. No nuclear weapons.

outcomes.Message: North, this is it. Hold Brussels, take every southern airbase and destroy the factories at Charleroi.
South, this is it. Take Brussels and every northern airbase, and destroy the factories at Zaventem.
